name: 80640 · Henderson, CO
findings: ZIP 80640 (Henderson) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80640 (Henderson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80640 (Henderson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
